hero.title: Privacy policy
hero.text: How we collect, use and protect your personal data.

body:
## Who we are

This website is operated by **ASSERT**, 34 Stenimachou Street, Nea Smyrni, Athens, Greece (“we”, “us”). We are the data controller for personal data processed through this website. You can contact us at [info@assert.gr](mailto:info@assert.gr).

## What data we collect

**Contact form.** When you send us a message we collect your name, email address, and — if you choose to provide them — your organisation, phone number, the topic of your enquiry and your message.

**Technical data.** To protect the form against abuse we record the IP address from which a message was sent. Our hosting provider may keep standard server logs (IP address, date and time, requested page, browser type) for security and troubleshooting.

We do **not** use advertising or tracking cookies, and we do not use third-party analytics that profile visitors.

## Why we use it and on what legal basis

| Purpose | Legal basis (GDPR) |
| --- | --- |
| Replying to your enquiry and taking steps before a possible contract | Art. 6(1)(b) and your consent, Art. 6(1)(a) |
| Protecting the website against spam and abuse | Our legitimate interest, Art. 6(1)(f) |
| Complying with legal obligations | Art. 6(1)(c) |

## How long we keep it

Enquiries are kept for as long as needed to handle your request and any resulting business relationship, and for no longer than 24 months after our last contact, unless the law requires us to keep them longer.

## Who we share it with

We do not sell your data. We share it only with service providers who help us run this website (such as our hosting provider), under contracts that require them to protect it, or with authorities where the law requires it. Data is stored within the European Economic Area.

## Your rights

You have the right to access, correct or delete your personal data, to restrict or object to its processing, to data portability, and to withdraw your consent at any time. To exercise these rights, email [info@assert.gr](mailto:info@assert.gr).

You also have the right to lodge a complaint with the Hellenic Data Protection Authority ([www.dpa.gr](https://www.dpa.gr)).

## Changes to this policy

We may update this policy from time to time. The date at the top of this page shows when it was last changed.
